_: One entry per narration line. `say` goes to the voice, `show` is the caption; both split by | into the same number of chunks, and a caption chunk shows while its words are spoken. `gap` is the silence before the line, in seconds. `act` names the music part the line belongs to; `scene` the picture.

lines.say: Every message you've ever sent... | had a witness.
lines.show: Every message you've ever sent… | had a witness.

lines.say: Someone in the middle. | Always awake. | Always reading along.
lines.show: Someone in the middle. | Always awake. | Always reading along.

lines.say: Boo wants to reach one friend. | Just one.
lines.show: Boo wants to reach one friend. | Just one.

lines.say: So Boo sends Casper an invitation. | A secret, meant for one.
lines.show: So Boo sends Casper an invitation. | A secret, meant for one.

lines.say: Between them lies a vast, dark crowd. | Millions of strangers. | No owner. | No boss.
lines.show: Between them lies a vast, dark crowd. | Millions of strangers. | No owner. | No boss.

lines.say: Boo leaves a little note in the crowd... | sealed. | To everyone else, it's just noise.
lines.show: Boo leaves a little note in the crowd… | sealed. | To everyone else, it's just noise.

lines.say: But Casper's invitation | knows exactly where to look.
lines.show: But Casper's invitation | knows exactly where to look.

lines.say: A note. | A reply. | A whisper, answered.
lines.show: A note. | A reply. | A whisper, answered.

lines.say: They agree on how to talk... | and step out of the crowd.
lines.show: They agree on how to talk… | and step out of the crowd.

lines.say: Now it's just the two of them. | Peer to peer. | Nobody in between.
lines.show: Now it's just the two of them. | Peer to peer. | Nobody in between.

lines.say: And the notes? | They fade. | The crowd forgets.
lines.show: And the notes? | They fade. | The crowd forgets.

lines.say: Find your people. | Vanish from everyone else.
lines.show: Find your people. | Vanish from everyone else.
